options.how: Starts each climb with a basic deck; cards picked after fights, relics and map pathing build the deck within that one run.
Players own a persistent card collection and bring premade or self-built decks into matches.

sources.note: Slay the Spire: dynamic deck building, add cards to your deck with each attempt
Hearthstone: premade decks, optional card purchases, ranked ladder

options.how: Each run starts from a clan deck; route choices add units, spells and card upgrades between battles.
An account-wide collection persists; decks for events are built from the cards you own.

sources.note: Monster Train: roguelike deck building, recruit units and upgrade cards by route
Magic: The Gathering Online: collect cards, build decks from your Magic Online collection

options.how: Acquires woodland creature cards during the run through drafts and card-altering events like surgery.
A persistent collection of Witcher cards grows over time; players construct a deck before PvP duels.

sources.note: Inscryption: acquire a deck of woodland creature cards by draft, surgery
Gwent: collect heroes and cards, careful deck construction for PvP duels

options.how: Your class's ability deck grows as you level up and loot across a randomly generated dungeon run.
Earn and trade cards to grow a collection, then build ever more intricate decks from it to challenge opponents.

sources.note: Dream Quest: abilities are a deck of cards that you develop as you progress through levels
Pokemon Trading Card Game: trade cards you've earned, build more intricate decks

options.how: Each journey starts with a chosen tribe; companions and items join the deck along the way.
Cards unlock into a persistent collection; you choose 12 of them for a deck before each match.

sources.note: Wildfrost: build up a deck of card companions and items, begin each journey with a chosen tribe
Marvel Snap: collectible card game, 12-card decks

options.how: Battle and negotiation cards are collected during each campaign run, shaped by the jobs and friends you take on.
Duelists keep a card collection and build Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG decks before online Duels.

sources.note: Griftlands: deck-building rogue-like, every decision matters including the cards you collect
Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel: the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG played digitally, trading card game deckbuilding

options.how: Your crew's orders are cards; the deck is assembled and grown within each roguelike run.
Collect cards into an account-wide collection and build and refine decks from it before matches.

sources.note: Cobalt Core: sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder, give orders to your crew by playing cards
Magic: The Gathering Arena: collect, build and master your unique deck

options.how: Pick two heroes and build their deck during a roguelike run, chaining combos between them.
Cards stay in your collection; Draft and Sealed modes let you keep the cards you pick or open.

sources.note: Roguebook: roguelike deckbuilder, build a team of two heroes and unleash combos
Eternal: Draft keeps what you draft, Sealed League cracks 14 packs, constructed decks

options.how: Poker hands score chips times mult; Jokers add to or multiply mult to beat each blind's target score.
Cards deal damage, block and apply effects to defeat the enemies in each encounter.

sources.note: Balatro: Mult multiplies the chips of the played poker hand; Jokers add mult
Slay the Spire: select cards that work together to dispatch foes

options.how: Each bird extends a chain of powers in its habitat row, so later turns lay more eggs, draw more cards or gather more food.
Units and fast-spells clash in tactical combat, with counterplay possible on the opponent's turn.

sources.note: Wingspan: each bird extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your habitats
Eternal: strategic gameplay and counterplay with fast-spells and tactical combat

options.how: No combat: control two of three locations after six turns, with card abilities and location effects swinging each one.
A solitaire deck of monsters is fought with swords, shields and potions until the deck is cleared.

sources.note: Marvel Snap: battle across three locations, control two of them after six turns to win
Card Crawl: fight through a deck of monsters with swords, shields and potions

options.how: Buy cards to grow a deck engine; whoever holds the most Victory Points in their deck at game end wins.
Combat is the card game: your deck of abilities is played against monsters on each dungeon floor.

sources.note: Dominion: collect as many Victory Points as you can by building a powerful deck
Dream Quest: combat is a card game, abilities are a deck of cards

note: Dominion is the 2008 board game, played here through its official digital adaptation.

options.how: Acquire mines, transport and artisans that turn raw gems into jewels, snowballing toward prestige and nobles.
Cards deploy units and spells across three vertical floors to stop invaders reaching the pyre.

sources.note: Splendor: acquire mines, transportation and artisans, attract nobles and earn prestige
Monster Train: three vertical play fields to defend the burning pyre

options.how: Builds toward one huge scoring hand each round: Joker synergies stack chips and mult against the blind.
Companion cards and items battle enemy cards on a board; you win by defeating them.

sources.note: Balatro: combine poker hands with Joker cards to earn enough chips to beat blinds
Wildfrost: card companions and items battle to banish the frost

options.how: Cards are laid into expeditions and wagers raise the stakes on them; the most successful expeditions after 3 rounds win.
Cards move the ship, raise shields and fire along a single axis to dodge and disable the enemy ship.

sources.note: Lost Cities: plan expeditions, place wagers, most successful expeditions after 3 rounds wins
Cobalt Core: single-axis combat, raise shields, dodge, strike enemy weapons

options.how: Birds you play make you better at laying eggs, drawing cards or gathering food, so the engine compounds every turn.
Cards resolve both fights and negotiations against opponents, turn by turn.

sources.note: Wingspan: each bird makes you better at laying eggs, drawing cards, or gathering food
Griftlands: deck-building rogue-like where you fight and negotiate

options.how: A roguelike deckbuilder: each run you pick clans, then recruit units and upgrade cards on the way through Hell, Heaven and the Abyss.
Open two free booster packs a day to grow a lasting card collection, then build decks from the cards you own.

sources.note: Monster Train 2: roguelike deckbuilder; choose clans, recruit units and upgrade cards during a run
Pokemon Trading Card Game Pocket: open two booster packs every day at no cost, collect digital cards, build your dream deck
